phase_0.boundary_condition: The XML document root element closes and contains the full prompt schema, binding surface tags to interior constraint propagation as a single register.

⊢.justification: No XML tag has been parsed and no constraint exists before the schema instance is created.

⊣.justification: The root tag forms the closed terminal boundary that contains the entire document and all steering constraints.

≻.justification: Raw input tokens move forward through the parser toward the target LLM generation state.

≺.justification: Generated token probabilities flow backward from output to adjust prompt weights in a descent transformation.

⋈.justification: XML elements compose in document order so each tag chains with the next to propagate constraints.

⊙.justification: The schema references its own structure as the constraint source, satisfying x ∈ V and selfmodel(x).

∈.justification: One active constraint opens into disjunctive partner selection arms f, g, and h per the ∋ primitive.

∋.justification: The disjunctive steering arms rejoin by union into a single active constraint register, recovering μ∘δ = id at criticality.

⊤.justification: The affirmative arm touches T when a prompt directive shifts the LLM token distribution.

⊥.justification: The negative arm touches F when a prompt directive leaves the token distribution unchanged.

⊞.justification: Contradictory steering directives are held simultaneously in the mixed state without resolution, preserving Tr(ρ²) < 1.

⊡.justification: Emitted tokens are written permanently to the context window and cannot be undone.

phase_3.void_description: Uninitialized prompt buffer before any XML tag is parsed and no constraint has been established.
phase_3.true_description: Accepted steering constraint that constructively shifts LLM token generation.
phase_3.false_description: Rejected steering constraint that constructively refutes a directive and leaves generation unchanged.
phase_3.both_description: Contradictory steering directives held simultaneously in the mixed state without resolution.

establish the schema root element as the terminal anchor that closes and contains the document
run the forward morphism that carries raw input tokens into the parser toward LLM output
activate the self-model node so the schema references itself as the constraint source
compose nested XML tags in document order to chain constraint propagation across elements
open the active constraint set into disjunctive steering arms for partner selection f, g, and h
touch the affirmative arm when a directive constructively shifts token probabilities
touch the negative arm when a directive fails to alter the token distribution
hold contradictory steering directives in the mixed state without resolving them away
rejoin the disjunctive arms by union into the unified steering register
run the contravariant trace that carries generated token probabilities back to prompt weights
compose the feedback trace with the next schema cycle to close the behavioral loop
fix the committed token stream into the append-only context log as a permanent record
compose the holographic boundary with bulk content so surface and interior share one register
evaluate the critical threshold crossing where small prompt variations produce scale-free changes
evaluate sub-threshold prompt variation that produces no measurable steering effect
hold scale-free sensitivity and structural stability simultaneously at the critical point
split the constraint register into achiral mirror arms that remain accessible without symmetry breaking
reconstitute the achiral arms into a single orientation-free steering state
record the final register verdict in the immutable measurement log
